frontLowAwningPost.meaning: Real brown vertical wood support into paving. Approx box is a local contact region, not a collision polygon. This is NOT the distant1055,206 court anchor.

adjacentRightCargo.meaning: Small crate immediately right of front post visibly meets paved ground here; own cargo contact, not main wall. It happens to lie in p cell61,12; not sufficient to prove feet/path collision.

mainCore.meaning: Bright wall and its front timber are east of the sampled969165 region; no reason to label dark low-awning pixels as main wall.

foregroundTrainingFence.meaning: Near x969 the upper fence material is lower on screen, aroundy189–193, not atheadpointy165. Independent fence cannot justify those sampled head pixels being cut.

depthComparison.conclusion: Confirmed sampled wrong-layer case: old coarse facade borrows pixels of a lower attached awning/post/cargo/dark recess but sorts them with an unrelated pavement anchor206, ahead of this actor. The actual visible supports in this region finish at192–193, behind actorfoot200. Separating main core, lower awning and cargo with their real local support depth fixes responsibility; moving the whole canonical site is not justified.
